notes: Pd23d994ba8 G4. Printed: 'Haste (This creature can attack and {T} as soon as it comes under your control.)' The probe only attacks with a card that was on the battlefield since the turn began, so haste never mattered there. Here seat 0 casts the 3/3 Minotaur and puts a vanilla 2/2 onto the battlefield the same turn, then tries to attack with both: the Minotaur attacks (haste, CR 702.10) and deals 3 (20 -> 17); the 2/2 is summoning sick (CR 302.6) and does not attack.
